tokens.name: surface-editor
tokens.usage: Editor writing surface and note list. The ground for almost all text. ≈ NSColor.textBackgroundColor.

tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Window chrome and Settings panes. The sidebar sits on system vibrancy over this, so treat it as an approximation there. ≈ NSColor.windowBackgroundColor.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Composer card, keycaps, the Saved toast: small surfaces that sit on a material. Approximation; the app uses system materials.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: note titles, body copy, sidebar rows. On every surface in both themes (≥12:1 on surface-editor). ≈ NSColor.labelColor.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Card previews, relative dates, the 'Edited…' line, counts. ≈ NSColor.secondaryLabelColor. KNOWN MISS: 3.98:1 on surface-editor and 3.84:1 on surface-window in Light, below 4.5:1 for its 11–12 pt uses. It is the system value, kept exact; dark theme passes (5.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders only ('Start writing…', 'Jot down a quick note…'). Never for content: 1.8:1 Light, 2.3:1 Dark.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 0.5 pt separators, table borders, card and composer outlines. Source range is 8–12% of primary; this is the middle.

tokens.name: fill-quiet
tokens.usage: Code block and inline code backgrounds, toolbar button hover, table header row tint. Approximation of the dynamic alphas in EditorStyles.swift.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Stands in for the user's system accent (default Blue); the app never hard-codes a brand accent. Active toolbar buttons, filled checkboxes, focus ring, prominent CTAs, All Notes icon. As text: 4.0:1 on surface-editor Light, 4.6:1 Dark: use for icons and ≥13 pt semibold labels, not small body text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: The check glyph inside a filled checkbox and the label on a prominent CTA. White on accent is the system pair (4.0:1 Light, 3.65:1 Dark): fine as a mark, short of 4.5:1 for small text. Kept exact.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3 px ring, the macOS convention. ≥3.4:1 on surface-editor and surface-window in both themes.

tokens.name: pinned
tokens.usage: Pin icons, the Pinned sidebar row and its empty state. ≈ NSColor.systemOrange. Icon only, never text: 2.2:1 on surface-editor Light; the word 'Pinned' always sits beside it.

tokens.name: recent
tokens.usage: The Recent sidebar icon. ≈ NSColor.systemTeal. Icon only, never text (2.6:1 Light).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The check glyph in the 'Saved to Inbox' toast. ≈ NSColor.systemGreen. Below 3:1 on light surfaces (2.2:1), so the toast's words carry the meaning; never colour alone.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: The Discard button in Quick Capture and delete confirmations. ≈ NSColor.systemRed. 3.55:1 on surface-editor Light, short of 4.5:1 for its 13 pt label: kept exact, and the word 'Discard' carries the meaning.

tokens.name: notebook-blue
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 1 (Inbox). Fixed in both themes. Notebook colours paint glyphs, list dots and tinted chips, never body text. 3.65:1 on white.

tokens.name: notebook-indigo
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 2. Fixed in both themes. 5.1:1 on white, 3.3:1 on surface-editor Dark.

tokens.name: notebook-purple
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 3 (Shortcuts). Fixed in both themes. 3.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: notebook-pink
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 4. Fixed in both themes. 3.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: notebook-red
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 5. Fixed in both themes. 3.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: notebook-orange
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 6 (Ideas). Fixed in both themes. KNOWN MISS as a glyph on white: 2.1:1; the notebook name always sits beside it.

tokens.name: notebook-yellow
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 7. Fixed in both themes. KNOWN MISS on white: 1.4:1. Fine in Dark (11.8:1); in Light it relies on the notebook name beside it.

tokens.name: notebook-green
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 8. Fixed in both themes. KNOWN MISS on white: 2.0:1; relies on the name beside it.

tokens.name: notebook-teal
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 9. Fixed in both themes. KNOWN MISS on white: 1.7:1; relies on the name beside it.

tokens.name: notebook-gray
tokens.usage: Notebook palette, swatch 10. Fixed in both themes. 3.3:1 on white, 5.1:1 on surface-editor Dark.

tokens.name: tile-show-hide
tokens.usage: Settings › Shortcuts tile for Show / Hide NoteIt.

tokens.name: tile-new-note
tokens.usage: Settings › Shortcuts tile for New Note.

tokens.name: tile-quick-capture
tokens.usage: Settings › Shortcuts tile for Quick Capture.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: The NoteIt brand colour: app icon ground, Quick Capture tile, lockup tiles, marketing. Fixed in both themes. White on it is 4.6:1, so white lockups and labels are fine at any size.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Logo ink: the single-colour mark and wordmark on light grounds, the dark app icon ground, the heading line on the page. Fixed in both themes; 1.2:1 on surface-editor Dark, so on dark grounds switch the mark to white or ink.

tokens.name: brand-pencil
tokens.usage: The speed streaks in the app icon. Decorative only, never text; 1.5:1 on white, so it only appears on brand-violet or brand-deep.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: The note page in the app icon and the light lockup tile. Fixed in both themes; brand-deep on it is 13:1.

families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Body size + 12. One per note, usually the first line. 10 pt after.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Body size + 5. 10 pt before, 6 pt after.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Body size + 1.5. 6 pt before, 4 pt after.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notes that keep up with your thinking.
styles.usage: The default 15 pt; the user sets 11–24 pt in Settings › Editor and every editor style scales from it. 6 pt after.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Body size, 18 pt indent with a vertical bar in hairline.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Body size − 1, first table row only, on fill-quiet, 8 pt cell padding.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: Body size − 1 in SF Mono, 14 pt inset, on fill-quiet with radius-card corners.

styles.name: inline-code
styles.usage: Body size − 1, medium, on fill-quiet. Also the keycap face.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Note card title; 'New Note' in ink-secondary when the note is empty.

styles.name: card-preview
styles.sample: Press ⌘N for a new note, ⌘F to search…
styles.usage: Note card preview, two lines max, ink-secondary.

styles.name: card-meta
styles.usage: Relative date and notebook name on cards, ink-secondary.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Sidebar rows, menu bar panel rows, Settings labels.

styles.name: row-meta
styles.usage: Menu bar row preview and short time ('15m', 'Yesterday', 'Mon').

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Menu bar section headers. Always set in uppercase (text-transform: uppercase), +0.6 tracking, ink-secondary.

styles.name: capture-title
styles.usage: The Title field in Quick Capture.

styles.name: capture-body
styles.usage: The body area in Quick Capture.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: SF Pro Heavy Italic, tight. The logotype beside the Swift Page mark; the italic leans the same way the note flies in. Always two-tone: "Note" in the lockup ink, "It" in the accent tone (brand-violet on light grounds, brand-pencil on brand-deep or dark, brand-deep on brand-violet), because in SF Pro a capital I is a plain bar and a one-colour NoteIt reads as Notelt. Outline it to paths for production artwork.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: icon to count, keycap to keycap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing after body; heading after.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between card lines.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space after title; before heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card padding; row gaps in the menu bar panel.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Code block inset.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding in Quick Capture and the menu bar panel.

tokens.name: quote-indent
tokens.usage: Block quote indent, bar included.

tokens.name: editor-inset-y
tokens.usage: Minimum vertical inset of the writing surface.

tokens.name: editor-inset-x
tokens.usage: Minimum horizontal inset of the writing surface.

tokens.name: radius-toolbar
tokens.usage: Formatting toolbar buttons. All corners are continuous (squircle) in the app.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Hotkey tiles in Settings › Shortcuts.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Composer card, code blocks, note cards.

tokens.name: radius-preview
tokens.usage: The New Notebook icon preview tile.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Quick Capture panel.

tokens.name: radius-glyph
tokens.usage: Notebook glyph tiles: 28% of the tile's side, whatever its size.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Notebook chip in the note header, Saved toast.

size.note: Fixed component and window sizes from the current build, in points.

tokens.name: hairline-width
tokens.usage: Every separator and outline.

tokens.name: toolbar-button-w
tokens.usage: Formatting toolbar button width.

tokens.name: toolbar-button-h
tokens.usage: Formatting toolbar button height.

tokens.name: empty-state-circle
tokens.usage: Tinted circle behind an empty-state symbol.

tokens.name: about-icon
tokens.usage: App icon in Settings › About.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the editor text column, centred.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar ideal width (190–320).

tokens.name: note-list-w
tokens.usage: Note list ideal width (240–440).

tokens.name: menubar-panel-w
tokens.usage: Menu bar panel width (460 tall).

tokens.name: capture-w
tokens.usage: Quick Capture panel width (330 tall).

tokens.name: settings-w
tokens.usage: Settings window width.

tokens.name: tint-chip
tokens.usage: Notebook colour at this opacity fills the note-header chip.

tokens.name: tint-glyph
tokens.usage: Notebook colour at this opacity fills glyph tiles and menu bar glyph backgrounds; also empty-state circles.
